Step 3 — Start the backend server in background, with all required env vars set, writing stdout+stderr to the log file. Use PowerShell Start-Process: $proc = Start-Process -FilePath '.\zig-out\bin\bpm-platform.exe' -RedirectStandardOutput $logFile -RedirectStandardError $logFile -PassThru -WorkingDirectory 'C:\Users\tvolo\dev\ai-dala\My-Fab' -Environment @{ BPM_DB_URL='postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test'; BPM_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN='test-trace-token'; BPM_ENV='development'; BPM_LOG_LEVEL='DEBUG'; BPM_PORT='8080' }. Step 7 — Capture the build summary line from the output. It MUST show 375/375 tests passed (0 skipped). If any tests still skip or fail, read the detailed output and diagnose.

Step 9 — Report PASS if 375/375 passed. Report FAIL with details if any test skipped or failed.

important_notes: The bootstrap token mechanism: when BPM_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN=test-trace-token is set in BPM_ENV=development, any request with Authorization: Bearer test-trace-token is authenticated as PLATFORM_ADMIN. The tests set BPM_TEST_TOKEN=test-trace-token which they use as the bearer token.

TC-API-09-INT-03 and TC-OBS-01-INT-01 read BPM_TEST_LOG_FILE to find trace IDs in structured log output. The log file MUST be the backend server's structured JSON log output (stdout/stderr redirected to file). The tests look for JSON lines containing 'trace_id':'<value>'.

TC-API-09-INT-01 expects GET /api/v1/definitions with bearer token to return HTTP 200. TC-API-09-INT-04 expects GET /api/v1/definitions/{uuid} to return 404. TC-API-09-INT-05 expects GET /api/v1/definitions WITHOUT auth to return 401.

If Start-Process -Environment does not work, set env vars in the PowerShell session before calling Start-Process: $env:BPM_DB_URL = 'postgres://...'; $env:BPM_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN = 'test-trace-token'; etc., then Start-Process without -Environment.

The backend may need migrations applied. Since BPM_DB_URL points to the test DB (5433) and migrations have already been applied there (368 integration tests pass against it), no migration step is needed.

If the build fails, check for compile errors. The binary at zig-out/bin/bpm-platform.exe was built today so a rebuild may be redundant — try starting the existing binary first if zig build fails due to output lock.
WINDOWS LOCK: zig-out/bin/bpm-platform.exe may be locked by the OS while running. If zig build fails with a lock error, skip the rebuild and use the existing binary.
After Step 8 (killing the server), wait 2 seconds before reporting to ensure process is fully terminated.
